title: Rust: Event Bus / Pub-Sub
description: Implement an event bus with publish/subscribe pattern and message filtering.

steps.title: Basic Event Bus
steps.description: Create an `EventBus` struct that stores subscribers per event type: `HashMap<String, Vec<Box<dyn Fn(&str)>>>`. Implement `on(event, callback)` and `emit(event, data)`. Test with a simple event.
hints: `on` pushes a new callback to the event's subscriber list.
`emit` iterates subscribers and calls each with data.

verification.failureMessage: Register a subscriber and emit an event.

steps.title: Unsubscribe by ID
steps.description: Add unique subscription IDs using an atomic counter. `on` returns a `SubscriptionId`. Add `unsubscribe(id)` to remove a subscriber. Demonstrate subscribing then unsubscribing.
hints: Store `(SubscriptionId, Box<dyn Fn(&str)>)` instead of just callbacks.
`unsubscribe` removes by ID from the Vec.

verification.failureMessage: Subscribe, then unsubscribe and verify no more events received.

steps.title: Wildcard Events
steps.description: Add wildcard support: subscribe to `"user.*"` to receive all user events (`"user.created"`, `"user.deleted"`, etc.). Test with multiple event types.
hints: Check if subscriber pattern matches event using `event.starts_with(pattern.strip_suffix('*'))`

verification.failureMessage: Subscribe with 'user.*' and show it receives all user events.

steps.title: Async Event Bus with Queue
steps.description: Add an event queue: events are pushed to a queue and processed asynchronously. Use `std::sync::mpsc::channel` to queue events. Print processing order.
hints: Use a channel to queue (event_type, data) pairs.
Process queue in a separate thread.

verification.failureMessage: Queue events and show they are processed asynchronously.

steps.title: Event Stats and Monitoring
steps.description: Add metrics: total events emitted, events per type, subscriber count. Print a stats report showing the most active event types.
hints: Track `event_counts: HashMap<String, u64>` incremented on each emit.
Add a `stats()` method that prints all counters.
Emit several events of different types and print the report.

verification.failureMessage: Emit multiple events and print statistics.
